objective: Make Cloud IaC provider-readiness a first-class fail-closed local Oya gate by binding each local module-catalog row to intended provider families, explicit provider source addresses, reusable-module minimum version constraints, and future lock/signature/provenance requirements while preserving provider HCL materialization, provider dependency lockfiles, provider installation, provider provenance, module signing, SLSA attestations, tofu test/plan/apply, and provider-resource-complete modules as explicit non-claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: Each future provider family uses an explicit provider source address and a minimum provider version constraint; reusable modules do not set maximum constraints in this inventory.
Lockfiles are provider dependency evidence created/updated by init and should be reviewed/committed separately; this ChangeSet explicitly keeps provider lockfiles non-materialized.
Future lock evidence should pre-populate platform checksums and requires signer review; this ChangeSet records future lock requirements only and does not run providers lock.
SLSA provenance/verification summary remains a future supply-chain evidence slice; this ChangeSet does not emit SLSA attestations.
The OCI family inventory uses the current OpenTofu Registry public source address registry.opentofu.org/opentofu/oci while still refusing provider install, lock, or live OCI API claims.
